**# Instructions for Accurately Documenting Reportable Workplace Accidents**

These instructions cover the process from the immediate aftermath of an accident through to final reporting and investigation.  "Reportable" refers to accidents that meet the criteria established by OSHA (in the US) or your local equivalent regulatory body (e.g., HSE in the UK, WorkSafe in Australia).  **Always check your local regulations to understand what constitutes a reportable incident.**  Generally this includes fatalities, hospitalizations, amputations, loss of an eye, and certain serious injuries.
